steps.description: Determine the planned road trip route across the country.
Calculate distances and estimated travel times for the planned route.
Identify points of interest and recommended stops along the route.
Retrieve current exchange rates for relevant currencies for expense management.
Search for budget-friendly restaurants along the planned route.
Search for budget-friendly hotels along the planned route.
Track and manage expenses incurred during the road trip.
